entities.name: André Coyne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Coyne was a French civil engineer who founded the consulting firm Coyne et Bellier and was President of the International Commission on Large Dams from 1945 to 1953. He designed 70 dams in 14 countries during his lifetime.
